[[Rwek Khawl Mawl]] is a [[Hydra]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Perdition Rock]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ring of Fire Islands]]
** {{NPC location|Perdition Rock}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Cry of Frustration}}
* {{skill icon|Echo}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Energy Burn}}
* {{skill icon|Power Drain}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Mahgo Claw]]

== Notes ==
* This boss can appear in any of the four possible spawn locations. It shares these locations with [[Nayl Klaw Tuthan]] and [[Rull Browbeater]].
* Unlike other Hydras, this foe is susceptible to being [[Knock down|knocked down]].

== Trivia ==
* All Hydra bosses have one name for each head.
* "Rwek Khawl Mawl" seems to be either a phonetic play on words that stands for "wreck, kill, maul" or "Wreck em All".
